mapper.select: SELECT mmfr.*, p.id AS 'project.id', p.name AS 'project.name', p.serial_number AS 'project.serial_number', p.short_name AS 'project.short_name', su.name AS user_name FROM mes_material_feeding_report mmfr LEFT JOIN contract_project p ON p.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND p.id = mmfr.project_id LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND su.id = mmfr.user_id WHERE mmfr.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mmfr.id = #{id}
